reasoning_traces.think:
This primitive formalizes wager allocation across outcomes i using Bayes' rule. Let O_i be outcome events with P(O_i) priors and observed data D. The optimal bet \pi_i maximizes expected utility of terminal wealth E[U(W_T)]. In sports betting, D might be player injuries or weather data. The Lagrangian yields a betting fraction \pi_i \propto P(D|O_i)P(O_i)/P(D). This connects to Kelly criterion when utility is logarithmic. Dualities emerge: maximizing log-wealth is equivalent to minimizing relative entropy (KL divergence) between forecast and realized outcomes. Failure occurs when P(D|O_i) deviates from IID assumptions, causing overfitting or systematic bias. In GSI, this maps to sequential Bayesian inference on market maker inventory. In GSE, it models optimal entry/exit timing under regime-switching volatility.
